Description
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
Northrop Grumman’s Defense System's
, Advanced Weapons Division is looking for a
Software Systems Engineer-Level 3/4
, located in
Northridge, CA
. This role will be 100% on-site with no hybrid opportunities. A current government issued secret clearance is required to start.
This person will support the Stand in Attack Weapon (SiAW) Program. As a member of the Software team, you’ll work in a fast-paced environment as the go between for the Software Engineering functional group and the Systems Engineering functional group. Candidate should possess Systems Engineering discipline knowledge with strong embedded software familiarity. Candidate will be responsible for analyzing, allocating requirements and specifications with various stakeholders.
Responsibilities
Responsible for translating system/subsystem level software requirements into software level requirements for each CSCI. Work with System and Software engineers to develop software architecture models. Support Verification and Validation of software product to ensure all integrated CSCIs function as intended. Experience in systems engineering including requirements analysis, requirements allocation, system design, software design, software implementation, software testing, system integration, field integration testing, and requirements verification. Experience in software/systems architecture using Cameo Enterprise Architecture (behavioral, structural, analytical) to develop use cases, activity diagrams and sequence diagrams. Familiarity in Writing Software Test Plans and Test Descriptions and running tests.
Basic Qualifications Principal Software Systems Engineer (Level 3)
Bachelor of Science in an Engineering discipline and a minimum of five (5) years of systems engineering experience with any exposure to requirements development and verification activities; or a Master’s of Science with a minimum of three (3) years of systems engineering experience with any exposure to requirements development and verification activities.
Experience in systems engineering tools, such as DOORS, CAMEO.
Experience in Embedded Software, and ability to read code and verify the implementation per Software Requirements Specifications
Experience with system/subsystem/software/hardware integration, test, and verification
Experience in the defense industry and design in an aerospace environment
Current US Government Secret security clearance, adjudicated within the past 5 years
Basic Qualifications Sr. Principal Software Systems Engineer (Level 4)
Bachelor of Science in an Engineering discipline and a minimum of eight (8) years of systems engineering experience with any exposure to requirements development and verification activities; will consider Master of Science in an Engineering discipline and a minimum of six (6) years of systems engineering experience with any exposure to requirements development and verification activities.
Experience in systems engineering tools, such as DOORS, CAMEO.
Experience in Embedded Software, and ability to read code and verify the implementation per Software Requirements Specifications
Experience with system/subsystem/software/hardware integration, test, and verification
Experience in the defense industry and design in an aerospace environment
Current US Government Secret security clearance, adjudicated within the past 5 years
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in multiple aerospace and defense technologies (e.g., sensors, navigation aids, guidance electronics, controls, propulsion, structures, platforms).
Have technical knowledge in one or more military mission areas (e.g., Air, Land, Sea, Space, Cyber)
Experience in assessing legacy system architecture and innovation for future potential technology development.
